business_summary: Arbeit-Times Co., Ltd. engages in editing and publishing of free job information magazines under the DOMO name in Japan. The company offers DOMO, a part-time job listing magazine; DOMO NET, a part-time job recruitment website; Wagasha de DOMO, an applicant tracking system which allows to create own company's recruitment website; JOB, a job change information site; Job Fair, a job change/employment event; DOMO Pad, a job information magazine; Achieve Career, a Job placement agency service; Achieve Myanmar, a recruitment support service; Achieve Tech, IT education services; Tech Seed, a corporate programming training; TSUNORU, a new graduate recruitment information site for small and medium-sized companies; Tegara Miru, a employee retention support tools; wevox, an organizational issue visualization tool; NJSS, a bidding information bulletin services; and Nippon's CEO, a CEO interview site. Arbeit-Times Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
